title: Geometry-Aware Test-Time Learning for Quantitative Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantitative spatial reasoning in visual-language models (VLMs) aims to infer spatial distances and directional relationships among objects in 3D space from a 2D image and a natural language query. Despite recent progress, VLM spatial reasoning remains brittle under distribution shifts, largely due to the high cost of 3D supervision. As a result, models often produce inconsistent or contradictory predictions when faced with novel object configurations or rephrased spatial queries, revealing a misalignment between learned representations and underlying geometry. To address this, we propose TTL-SR, a geometry-aware Test-Time Learning framework for quantitative Spatial Reasoning that leverages geometric consistency constraints and unlabeled test data to adapt models to target domains. Specifically, TTL-SR augments the input query with geometrically coupled auxiliary queries, filters unreliable predictions via adaptive geometric triggering

translated_title: 面向定量空间推理的几何感知测试时学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.06004v1 公告类型：cross（交叉列表）。摘要：视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的定量空间推理旨在从2D图像和自然语言查询中推断3D空间中物体之间的空间距离和方向关系。尽管近期取得了进展，但由于3D监督标注的高昂成本，VLM的空间推理在分布偏移下仍然十分脆弱。因此，当面对新颖的物体配置或重新表述的空间查询时，模型常常产生不一致或矛盾的预测，这揭示了所学表示与底层几何结构之间的不对齐。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了TTL-SR，一个用于定量空间推理的几何感知测试时学习框架，该框架利用几何一致性约束和未标记的测试数据使模型适应目标域。具体而言，TTL-SR通过几何耦合的辅助查询来增广输入查询，并通过自适应几何触发机制过滤不可靠的预测……
tldr: 提出了一种几何感知的测试时学习框架TTL-SR，利用几何一致性约束和未标记测试数据，提升视觉-语言模型在分布偏移下进行定量空间推理的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: We propose TTL-SR, a geometry-aware test-time learning framework that leverages geometric consistency constraints and unlabeled test data to improve the robustness of quantitative spatial reasoning in VLMs under distribution shifts.
